name: DigitalOcean
description: DigitalOcean's hosted server manages App Platform apps and reads their deployments and logs.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (cloud.digitalocean.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
